book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: Wiruɡibɑ wesiɑnɑmɔ
bu kɑ Yesu ɡo
Ye Yesu u ɡɑri yi kpuro ɡeruɑ u kpɑ, u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
i yɛ̃ mɑ n tie sɔ̃ɔ yiru bu kɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru ko. Bɑ koo Tɔnun Bii tɔmbu nɔmu sɔndiɑ bu nùn ɡo dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑru wɔllɔ.
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobu bɑ mɛnnɑ Kɑifɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ.
Bɑ nɔɔ tiɑ kuɑ bu kɑ Yesu mwɑ ɡoo u kun yɛ̃ kpɑ bu nùn ɡo.
Adɑmɑ bɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ mɔ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑrun sɑnɑm, kpɑ n ku rɑɑ ko ɡidi bɑkɑ tɔmbun suunu sɔɔ.
Kurɔ ɡoo turɑre yɛ̃kɑ
Yesun wirɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu wɑ̃ɑ Betɑniɔ Simɔɔn yɛnuɔ wi u rɑɑ bɑrɑ disiɡiru mɔ,
kurɔ ɡoo nɑ win mi, u too burɑru nɛni te tɑ turɑre ɡobi bɛkɛɡiɑ yibɑ. U too te wukiɑ mɑ u turɑre ye yɛ̃kɑ Yesun wirɔ sɑnɑm mɛ u dimɔ.
Ye bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ wɑ mɛ, ben nuki ɡbisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u yeni kɑm koosiɑ.
Sɑ ko rɑɑ kpĩ su turɑre ye dɔrɑ kɑ ɡobi bɛkɛ kpɑ su sɑ̃ɑrobu yen ɡobi bɔnu kuɑ.
Yesu ɡiɑ ye bɑ ɡerumɔ, mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kɑ kurɔ wi wɔki. Gɑ̃ɑ ɡeenɑ u mɑn kuɑ.
Domi bɑɑdommɑwɑ sɑ̃ɑrobɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ, ɑdɑmɑ nɛnɑ, nɑ ǹ ko nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ bɛɛ bɑɑdommɑ.
U nɛn wɑsi turɑre ye wisi u kɑ nɛn sikubun sɔɔru ko.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑɑmɑ mi bɑ koo Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ yeni kpɑrɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ kpuro bɑ koo mɑɑ ɡere ye kurɔ wi kuɑ bɑ n kɑ nùn yɑɑye.
Yudɑsi u kĩ u Yesu yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu nɔmu sɔndiɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru yen turo wi bɑ mɔ̀ Yudɑsi Isikɑriɔtu, u dɑ u yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu deemɑ.
U bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ i ko i mɑn kɛ̃ nɑ̀ n bɛɛ Yesu nɔmu sɔndiɑ. Mɑ bɑ sii ɡeesun ɡobi tɛnɑ ɡɑrɑ bɑ nùn wɛ̃.
Sɑɑ sɑɑ yen diyɑ u swɑɑ kɑsu u kɑ nùn bu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Yesu u Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun
yɑɑ dibu dimɔ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu
Pɛ̃ɛ ye bɑ ǹ seeyɑtiɑ doken tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑrun tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru Yesun bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nɑ win mi, bɑ bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ ɑ kĩ su nun Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibun sɔɔru kuɑ.
Yesu bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, i doo wuu sɔɔ wɑɑnɛ kɑsɑn mi, kpɑ i nùn sɔ̃ nɑ nɛɛ, nɛn sɑɑ yɑ turɑ, win miyɑ kon Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibu di kɑ nɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu sɑnnu.
Bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ kuɑ nɡe mɛ Yesu bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ mɑ bɑ Gɔɔ sɑrɑribun yɑɑ dibu sɔɔru kuɑ.
Ye n kuɑ yokɑ, Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ye, bɑ mɛnnɑ bu kɑ di.
Nɡe mɛ bɑ dimɔ Yesu nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ bɛɛn turo koo mɑn dɔmɛ.
Bwɑ̃ɑ ben nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑmɔ tiɑ tiɑ bɑ mɔ̀, ɑsɑ n ǹ nɛ Yinni.
Yesu u wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɛ kɑ wi sɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛ teerɔ sɔ̃rɑmɔ, wiyɑ wi u koo mɑn dɔmɛ.
Tɔnun Bii u koo ɡbi nɡe mɛ Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi win ɡɑri mɔ̀, ɑdɑmɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑruɡiiwɑ wi u koo nùn dɔmɛ. N burɑm bo bɑ kun dɑɑ yɛ̃ro mɑrɑ.
Yudɑsi wi u koo nùn dɔmɛ u nɛɛ, ɑsɑ n ǹ nɛ yinni. Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, wunɑ mi.
Yinnin dĩɑ domɑruɡinu
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ dimɔ, Yesu pɛ̃ɛ suɑ. Ye u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ u kpɑ u ye mururɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, i mɔɔ i di, yeniwɑ nɛn wɑsi.
Yen biru u tɑm nɔrɑ suɑ. Ye u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ u kpɑ, u bu wɛ̃ u nɛɛ, i nɔruo bɛɛ kpuro.
Domi yeniwɑ nɛn yɛm, mɛ̀ sɔɔ Gusunɔ u win nɔɔ mwɛɛru sire, mɛ mu yɑri tɔn dɑbirun sɔ̃ bu kɑ torɑrun suuru wɑ.
Nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, sɑɑ tɛ̃n di nɑ ǹ mɑɑ tɑm mɛni nɔrumɔ sere dɔmɑ te nɛ kɑ bɛɛ sɑ ko tɑm kpɑm nɔ nɛn Bɑɑbɑn bɑndu sɔɔ.
Yen biru bɑ womusu kuɑ mɑ bɑ yɑrɑ bɑ dɑ Olifin ɡuuru wɔllɔ.
Yesu u nɛɛ, Piɛɛ koo nùn siki
Yerɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡisɔn wɔ̃ku te, bɛɛ kpuro i ko torɑ nɛn sɔ̃, domi bɑ yoruɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ, “Kon yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro ɡo, kpɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nu yɑrinɑ yɑm kpuro.”
Adɑmɑ nɑ̀ n seewɑ ɡɔrin di kon bɛɛ ɡbiiyɑ Gɑlileɔ.
Piɛɛ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑɑ be kpuro bɑ̀ n torɑ wunɛn sɔ̃, nɛnɑ kun torɑmɔ pɑi.
Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ, ɡisɔn wɔ̃ku te, ɡoo dɔɔ ɡu sere swĩ kɑɑ mɑn siki nɔn itɑ.
Piɛɛ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɑɑ sɑ̀ n ko ɡbi sɑnnu nɑ ǹ nun sikimɔ. Bwɑ̃ɑ be bɑ tie mɛyɑ ben tii bɑ ɡeruɑ.
Yesu u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ Gɛsemɑnɛɔ
Yerɑ Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ turɑ yɑm mi bɑ mɔ̀ Gɛsemɑnɛ. Mɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i sinɔ mini kpɑ n dɑ n kɑnɑru ko ɡiɔ.
U Piɛɛ kɑ Sebeden bibu yiru suɑ bɑ susi wuswɑɑɔ. Mɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu nùn deemɑ, win wɑsi dwiiyɑ.
Yerɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ sere n ɡɔɔ ɡum ɡirɑri. I yɔ̃ro mini i kɑ mɑn dom se.
U kɑ bu tondinɑ mɑ u kpunɑ u kibɑri u kɑnɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn Bɑɑbɑ, ǹ n ko n koorɑ, ɑ de wɑhɑlɑ ye, yu mɑn doonɑri. Adɑmɑ n ǹ mɔ nɡe mɛ nɑ kĩ mɑ n kun mɔ nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ.
Yen biru u wurɑmɑ bwɑ̃ɑbu itɑ yen mi, u deemɑ bɑ do mɑ u Piɛɛ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɑn nɑ, i kpɑnɑ i kɑ mɑn dom se bɑɑ kɔbi tiɑ.
I n dom serɑ kpɑ i n kɑnɑru mɔ̀ kpɑ i ku rɑ du kɔkiribu sɔɔ. Tɔnun ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kĩ ɑdɑmɑ wɑsi yen dɑm bie.
U kpɑm kɑ bu tondinɑ nɔn yiruse u kɑnɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn Bɑɑbɑ, wɑhɑlɑ yeni yɑ̀ kun koo mɑn doonɑri nɑ kun ye wɑ, ɑ de wunɛn kĩru tu koorɑ.
U kpɑm wurɑmɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbun mi mɑ u deemɑ bɑ do, domi ben nɔni buniɑ.
Yesu u kpɑm bu deri u doonɑ u kɑnɑru kuɑ nɔn itɑse kɑ ɡɑri tee yi.
Mɑ u kpɑm wurɑmɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbun mi u nɛɛ, i do kɑ tɛ̃ i wɛ̃rɑmɔ? Sɑɑ yɑ turuku koomɑ ye bɑ koo Tɔnun Bii tɔn kɔ̃sobu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Wee wi u koo nùn dɔmɛ u sisi, i seewo su kɑ bu yinnɑ.
Yesun mwɑɑbu
Yesu kun ɡɑri yi ɡerum kpɑ Yudɑsi kɑ tunumɑ, bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru yen turo. Tɔn dɑbi dɑbirɑ nùn swĩi bɑ tɑkobibɑ kɑ bokunu nɛni. Yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobɑ bɑ bu ɡɔrɑ.
Yudɑsi wi u koo Yesu dɔmɛ u rɑɑ bu yĩreru sɔ̃ɔsi u nɛɛ, wi kon nɛnɛ n bɔkɑsi, wiyɑ mi, i nùn mɔɔ.
Mii mii u susi Yesun mi u nɛɛ, yinni ɑ sɔ̃ɔ kpɑ n do? Mɑ u nùn nɛnuɑ u bɔkɑsi.
Yesu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bɔrɔ, ye ɑ kobu nɑ ɑ koowo. Yerɑ tɔn be, bɑ nɑ bɑ Yesu sɛ̃re bɑ mwɑ.
Yesun tɔmbun turo u win tɑkobi womɑ, u kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron yoon soo sɔ̃rɑ u burɑ.
Yerɑ Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn tɑkobi wesio yen kɑrɑrɔ, domi bɑɑwure wi u tɑkobi nɛni, tɑkobiwɑ yɑ koo nùn ɡo.
A ǹ yɛ̃ mɑ kon kpĩ n nɛn Bɑɑbɑ fɑɑbɑ kɑnɑ kpɑ u yɑnde mɑn wɔllun ɡɔrɑdobɑn wuunu ɡɔriɑmɑ n kere wɔkurɑ yiru?
Adɑmɑ nɑ̀ n kuɑ mɛ, ɑmɔnɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri yi koo kɑ yibiɑrɑ yi yi ɡerumɔ mɑ mɛyɑ kon kɑ ɡbi.
Mɑ Yesu u tɔn wɔru ɡe sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n weenɛ i mɑn mwɑɑbu nɑ kɑ tɑkobibɑ kɑ bokunu nɡe swɑɑ dio? Bɑɑdommɑwɑ nɑ rɑ n sɔ̃ kɑ bɛɛ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ nɑ n keu sɔ̃ɔsimɔ, i ǹ mɑɑ mɑn mwɑɑre.
Adɑmɑ ye kpuro yɑ koorɑwɑ kpɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbun ɡɑri yi kɑ koorɑ yi yi wɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri sɔɔ. Yerɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu kpuro bɑ nùn deri bɑ duki suɑ.
Bɑ Yesu sirimɔ Yuubɑn tɔnwerobun mɛnnɔ yerɔ
Be bɑ Yesu mwɑ bɑ kɑ nùn dɑ Kɑifɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron mi, mi woodɑ yɛ̃robu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobɑ mɛnnɛ.
Piɛɛ u Yesu swĩi dɑndɑnkuru sere kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnweron yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ. U duɑ yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ mɑ u sinɑ kɑ yɛnu kɔ̃sobu u kɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ ɡɑri yi, yi koo kɑ wiru ɡoorɑ.
Yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ ɡuro ɡurobun mɛnnɔ kpuro bɑ seedɑ weesuɡiɑ kɑsu bu Yesu mɑni bu wɑ bu kɑ nùn ɡo.
Adɑmɑ bɑ ǹ wɑ, bɑɑ mɛ seedɑɡii dɑbiru tɑ nɑ tɑ weesu kuɑ. Yen biru tɔmbu yiru ɡɑbɑ nɑ.
Bɑ nɛɛ, durɔ wini ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, u koo kpĩ u Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yeru surɑ kpɑ u tu bɑni sɔ̃ɔ itɑn bɑɑ sɔɔ.
Yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero u seewɑ u Yesu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ǹ ɡɛɛ wisimɔ? Mbɑn bweserɑ tɔn beni bɑ nun mɑnimɔ.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u mɑɑri. Mɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ bɔ̃ruo kɑ Gusunɔ Yinni wɑson yĩsiru, ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔwɔ ǹ n wunɛn nɑ Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ, ɑ sɑ̃ɑ win Bii.
Yesu nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, wunɛn tii ɑ ɡeruɑ kɔ. Adɑmɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ sɔ̃ɔ teeru i ko i Tɔnun Bii wɑ u sɔ̃ Gusunɔ Yinni dɑmɡiin nɔm ɡeuɔ. I ko mɑɑ nùn wɑ u wee ɡuru wirun di.
Yerɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwero u win tiin yɑberu nɛnuɑ u kɑrɑnɑ mɔrun sɔ̃ mɑ u nɛɛ, u Gusunɔ ɡɑri kɑm ɡerusi, seedɑɡii berɑ̀ sɑ kpɑm mɑrɑ. I nuɑ tɛ̃ ɡɑri kɑm ye u ɡeruɑ.
Amɔnɑ i wɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ, n weenɛwɑ bu nùn ɡo.
Yen biru bɑ nùn yɑ̃ɑtɑm sie nɔniɔ, mɑ bɑ nùn nɔm kusɑ so, ɡɑbɑ nùn bɑɑri so.
Bɑ nɛɛ, Kirisi ɑ de Gusunɔ u nun sɔ̃, kpɑ ɑ sun sɔ̃ wi u nun so.
Piɛɛ u Yesu siki
Piɛɛ u sɔ̃ yɛnu yɑɑrɑɔ. Wɔndiɑ ɡoo u nùn susi u nɛɛ, wunɛn tii ɑ rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Yesu Gɑlileɡii wi sɑnnu.
Adɑmɑ u siki bɑɑwuren nɔni biru u nɛɛ nɑ ǹ yɛ̃ mbɑ ɑ ɡerumɔ.
Yen biru u seewɑ u dɑ yɛnu yɑɑrɑn kɔnnɔwɔ. Wɔndiɑ ɡoo kpɑm nùn wɑ mɑ u be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, durɔ wini u rɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ Yesu Nɑsɑrɛtiɡii wi.
Mɑ Piɛɛ kpɑm siki kɑ bɔ̃ri u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ durɔ wi yɛ̃.
Ye n tɛ fiiko be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi, bɑ susi Piɛɛn bɔkuɔ bɑ nɛɛ, kɑ ɡem, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ben turo, wunɛn ɡɑri ɡeru ɡerusu nun terɑsiɑ.
Yerɑ u bɔ̃ruɑ u sɔnnɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ durɔ wi yɛ̃. Mii mii mɑ ɡoo dɔɔ ɡɑ swĩ.
Mɑ Piɛɛ u Yesun ɡɑri yi yɑɑyɑ yi u rɑɑ ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, ɡoo dɔɔ ɡu sere swĩ kɑɑ mɑn siki nɔn itɑ. U yɑrɑ tɔɔwɔ u swĩ ɡem ɡem.
